e.title: CIA（加拿大精算师协会）：三监察委员会、强制职业操守模块与职业操守工作坊
e.title_en: CIA (Canadian Institute of Actuaries): three oversight boards, a mandatory professionalism module and a professionalism workshop
e.title_hk: CIA（加拿大精算師協會）：三監察委員會、強制職業操守模組與職業操守工作坊
e.summary: 加拿大精算师协会（英法双语）：设精算准则委员会、职业行为委员会与职业操守及资格监察委员会三个监察机构，并发布职业行为规则、强制职业操守模块与虚拟职业操守工作坊
e.summary_en: The Canadian Institute of Actuaries (bilingual English and French): it runs three oversight bodies — an Actuarial Standards Board, a Professional Conduct Board and a Professionalism and Credential Monitoring Board — and publishes Rules of Professional Conduct alongside a mandatory professionalism module and a virtual professionalism workshop
e.summary_hk: 加拿大精算師協會（英法雙語）：設精算準則委員會、職業行為委員會與職業操守及資格監察委員會三個監察機構，並發布職業行為規則、強制職業操守模組與虛擬職業操守工作坊
e.body:
**CIA（Canadian Institute of Actuaries / Institut canadien des actuaires，加拿大精算师协会）** 是**加拿大的精算专业团体**（站点为英法双语，标题实测 **「Homepage - Canadian Institute of Actuaries | Institut canadien des actuaires」**）。本条目补的是**「把职业操守做成必修教育」这一形态**——**同类机构（[[ifoa]]、[[aae]]、[[actuaries-institute]]）多以准则与纪律为主**，而 **CIA 的实测结构显示它同时设有监察机构、行为规则、强制模块与工作坊**。⭐ **与池内已有条目的分工**：**池内已有 [[cia-ai-practitioner]]**，**但那是 CIA 的一则 AI 立场/新闻条目**；**本条目补的是「CIA 这个机构本身及其职业操守治理架构」**。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：站点首页 **256.7KB**；⭐ **「Professionalism（职业操守）」页 `/professionalism/` 实测 197.2KB，标题「Professionalism - Canadian Institute of Actuaries | Institut canadien des actuaires」**；⭐ **「Professional conduct（职业行为）」页 `/profession-oversight/professional-conduct-board/` 实测 202.5KB**；⭐ **「Conduct and complaints（行为与投诉）」页 `/professionalism/conduct-and-complaints/` 实测 199.9KB**；⭐ **「Rules of Professional Conduct and why they are important（职业行为规则及其重要性）」页 `/being-a-member/rules-of-professional-conduct-and-why-they-are-important/` 实测 251.0KB**；⭐ **「Mandatory Professionalism Module（强制职业操守模块）」页 `/being-a-member/mandatory-professionalism-module/` 实测 235.3KB**；⭐ **「Virtual Professionalism Workshop（虚拟职业操守工作坊）」页 `/courses-and-exams/professionalism-workshop/` 实测 193.8KB**。**导航逐字实测揭示的架构**：**Profession Oversight（职业监察）** 下含 ⭐ **Actuarial Standards Board（精算准则委员会）**、⭐ **Professional Conduct Board（职业行为委员会）**、⭐ **Professionalism and Credential Monitoring Board（职业操守与资格监察委员会）**——**三个并列监察机构**；**Professionalism** 下含 **CPD FAQ** 与 **Conduct and complaints**；**Being a member** 下含 **Continuing Professional Development（持续专业发展）**、**Mandatory Professionalism Module**、**Standards of Practice**、**Rules of Professional Conduct and why they are important**；**Courses and exams** 下含 **Professionalism Workshop** 与 ⭐ **Advanced Professionalism and Leadership Course（APLC，高级职业操守与领导力课程）**。

对 RIAA：**① 补上「职业操守被制度化为一门必修教育」这一形态**——**多数职业团体的职业操守是「写在文件里」**（**如 [[asb-us]] 的准则、同轮 [[abcd]] 的纪律**），**而 CIA 实测设有「强制职业操守模块」与「虚拟职业操守工作坊」，另有 APLC 高级课程**；**即把「操守」做成必须完成的学分与可参加的课程**——**对准备入行、需要做 CPD 的学生，这是「职业操守怎么被考核」的具体样本**（可与 [[ifoa]]、[[actuaries-institute]]、[[cii]]、[[anziif]]、[[loma]] 的继续教育体系对照）。**② ⭐ 「三个并列监察委员会」的架构值得单独注意**——**准则委员会（定标准）／职业行为委员会（管行为）／职业操守与资格监察委员会（查操守与资格）三者分开**；**这与同轮 [[asb-us]]（定准则）与 [[abcd]]（纪律）在美国分属不同机构形成对照：美国是「跨机构分工」，加拿大是「同一协会内设三个委员会」**——**两种自律架构的对照本身就是一个可写的题目**。**③ 「Rules of Professional Conduct and why they are important」这一页名值得注意**——**它不只列规则，还解释「为什么重要」**；**对做职业伦理教学的学生，这是一种可直接借鉴的呈现方式**。**④ 英法双语站点**——**对研究双语辖区监管与职业文件编制的学生有参考价值**（**注意：本次仅核实标题同时含英法名称，未核实两语版本内容是否等长**）。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到**首页与六个页面的存在、标题、页面体量、以及导航逐字实测的三委员会与教育架构**，**但未打开职业行为规则正文、未打开任何一条投诉或纪律案例、未打开强制模块或工作坊的任何内容、未核实 CPD 的具体学时要求**，因此**不能转述任何规则条款、案件、学时数值或课程内容**；**② ⭐ 「强制性」这一表述依据页面名「Mandatory Professionalism Module」与导航归属（Being a member）**，**本次未打开该页核实其适用范围、豁免条件与考核方式**——**故本词条不主张谁必须完成、何时完成、未完成有何后果**；**③ 「三个并列监察机构」的职能划分依据导航分组名与页面标题**，**本次未打开各委员会页面核实其权责边界**——**故词条内对三者职能的表述（定标准/管行为/查操守与资格）为**依据名称的**合理描述**，**已在此标注**；**④ CIA 与加拿大各省监管、与 [[osfi-canada-data]] 的关系本次未核实**（**池内已有 [[osfi-canada-data]]，但两者关系未核实，故不作关联陈述**）；**⑤ 英法两语版本的内容完整度是否一致未核实**；**⑥ CIA 的会员规模与成立年份未核实**；**⑦** 本词条**不主张** CIA 提供精算软件、模型或可下载数据**。**核实说明**：首页（256.7KB）与 `/professionalism/`（197.2KB）、`/profession-oversight/professional-conduct-board/`（202.5KB）、`/professionalism/conduct-and-complaints/`（199.9KB）、`/being-a-member/rules-of-professional-conduct-and-why-they-are-important/`（251.0KB）、`/being-a-member/mandatory-professionalism-module/`（235.3KB）、`/courses-and-exams/professionalism-workshop/`（193.8KB）均经**缓冲区安全探活工具 `discovery/probe-urls.sh`** HTTP 200 实测并逐字读取标题与导航；**未打开规则正文、投诉案例、模块或工作坊内容**。
e.body_en:
**CIA (the Canadian Institute of Actuaries / Institut canadien des actuaires)** is **Canada’s actuarial professional body** (the site is bilingual English and French, with a measured title of **"Homepage - Canadian Institute of Actuaries | Institut canadien des actuaires"**). This entry adds the **"professional conduct institutionalised as required education"** form — **peer bodies ([[ifoa]], [[aae]], [[actuaries-institute]]) lean on standards and discipline**, whereas **CIA’s measured structure shows oversight bodies, conduct rules, a mandatory module and a workshop together**. ⭐ **Division of labour with an existing entry**: **the corpus already holds [[cia-ai-practitioner]]**, **but that is a CIA AI position or news item**; **this entry adds the institution itself and its professionalism governance architecture**.

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): the homepage is **256.7KB**; ⭐ the **"Professionalism" page `/professionalism/` measures 197.2KB**; ⭐ the **"Professional conduct" page `/profession-oversight/professional-conduct-board/` measures 202.5KB**; ⭐ the **"Conduct and complaints" page measures 199.9KB**; ⭐ the **"Rules of Professional Conduct and why they are important" page measures 251.0KB**; ⭐ the **"Mandatory Professionalism Module" page measures 235.3KB**; ⭐ the **"Virtual Professionalism Workshop" page measures 193.8KB**. **Navigation read verbatim reveals the architecture**: under **Profession Oversight** — ⭐ an **Actuarial Standards Board**, ⭐ a **Professional Conduct Board** and ⭐ a **Professionalism and Credential Monitoring Board** (**three parallel oversight bodies**); under **Professionalism** — **CPD FAQ** and **Conduct and complaints**; under **Being a member** — **Continuing Professional Development**, the **Mandatory Professionalism Module**, **Standards of Practice** and the **Rules of Professional Conduct explainer**; under **Courses and exams** — the **Professionalism Workshop** and ⭐ an **Advanced Professionalism and Leadership Course (APLC)**.

For RIAA: **① it adds the form of professional conduct institutionalised as required education** — **most professional bodies keep conduct "written down in a document"** (**such as the standards in [[asb-us]] and the discipline in [[abcd]] this round**), **whereas CIA measurably runs a "Mandatory Professionalism Module", a "Virtual Professionalism Workshop" and an advanced APLC course**; **conduct is thus made into credits that must be completed and courses that can be attended** — **for students preparing to enter the field and needing CPD, this is a concrete sample of how professional conduct is assessed** (comparable with the continuing-education systems of [[ifoa]], [[actuaries-institute]], [[cii]], [[anziif]] and [[loma]]). **② ⭐ The three parallel oversight bodies deserve separate note** — **a standards board (setting standards), a professional conduct board (governing conduct) and a professionalism and credential monitoring board (monitoring conduct and credentials) are held apart**; **this contrasts with the same round’s [[asb-us]] (standards) and [[abcd]] (discipline) sitting in separate US bodies: the US separates across organisations, Canada creates three committees inside one institute** — **the comparison of the two self-regulation architectures is itself a writable topic**. **③ The page name "Rules of Professional Conduct and why they are important" is notable** — **it does not merely list rules but explains why they matter**, **a directly borrowable presentation for teaching professional ethics**. **④ A bilingual English-French site** — **useful for students studying bilingual jurisdictions and the drafting of professional documents** (**note: this check verified only that the title carries both names, not that the two language versions are of equal length**).

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **the homepage and six pages’ existence, titles and sizes, plus the three-committee and education architecture read verbatim from navigation**, **but opened no rules text, no complaint or discipline case, no module or workshop content, and did not establish specific CPD hour requirements**, so **no rule clause, case, hour figure or course content can be restated**; **② ⭐ the word "mandatory" rests on the page name "Mandatory Professionalism Module" and its navigation placement (under Being a member)**, **and that page was not opened to verify scope, exemptions or assessment** — **so this entry claims nothing about who must complete it, by when, or with what consequence**; **③ the division of functions among the three oversight bodies rests on navigation group names and page titles**, **and the individual committee pages were not opened to verify their remits** — **so the descriptions given in the entry (setting standards / governing conduct / monitoring conduct and credentials) are reasonable descriptions from those names, flagged here**; **④ the relationship between CIA, provincial Canadian regulation and [[osfi-canada-data]] was not verified** (**[[osfi-canada-data]] is in the corpus, but the relationship was not verified, so no linkage is asserted**); **⑤ whether the English and French versions are equal in content was not verified**; **⑥ CIA’s membership size and founding year were not verified**; **⑦** this entry **does not claim CIA provides actuarial software, models or downloadable data**. **Verification note**: the homepage (256.7KB) and `/professionalism/` (197.2KB), `/profession-oversight/professional-conduct-board/` (202.5KB), `/professionalism/conduct-and-complaints/` (199.9KB), `/being-a-member/rules-of-professional-conduct-and-why-they-are-important/` (251.0KB), `/being-a-member/mandatory-professionalism-module/` (235.3KB) and `/courses-and-exams/professionalism-workshop/` (193.8KB) were measured at HTTP 200 using the **buffer-safe probe tool `discovery/probe-urls.sh`**, with titles and navigation read verbatim; **no rules text, complaint case, module or workshop content was opened**.
e.body_hk:
**CIA（Canadian Institute of Actuaries／Institut canadien des actuaires，加拿大精算師協會）** 是**加拿大的精算專業團體**（站點為英法雙語）。本條目補的是**「把職業操守做成必修教育」這一形態**——**同類機構多以準則與紀律為主**，而 **CIA 的實測結構顯示它同時設有監察機構、行為規則、強制模組與工作坊**。⭐ **與池內已有條目的分工**：**池內已有 [[cia-ai-practitioner]]**，**但那是 CIA 的一則 AI 立場／新聞條目**；**本條目補的是「CIA 這個機構本身及其職業操守治理架構」**。

可核實資訊（**均 HTTP 200 實測**）：首頁 **256.7KB**；⭐ **「Professionalism」頁 197.2KB**；⭐ **「Professional conduct」頁 202.5KB**；⭐ **「Conduct and complaints」頁 199.9KB**；⭐ **「Rules of Professional Conduct and why they are important」頁 251.0KB**；⭐ **「Mandatory Professionalism Module」頁 235.3KB**；⭐ **「Virtual Professionalism Workshop」頁 193.8KB**。**導航逐字實測架構**：**Profession Oversight** 下含 ⭐ **Actuarial Standards Board**、⭐ **Professional Conduct Board**、⭐ **Professionalism and Credential Monitoring Board**（**三個並列監察機構**）；**Professionalism** 下含 **CPD FAQ** 與 **Conduct and complaints**；**Being a member** 下含 **CPD**、**Mandatory Professionalism Module**、**Standards of Practice**、**Rules of Professional Conduct and why they are important**；**Courses and exams** 下含 **Professionalism Workshop** 與 ⭐ **Advanced Professionalism and Leadership Course（APLC）**。

對 RIAA：**① 補上「職業操守被制度化為一門必修教育」**——**多數團體把操守「寫在文件裡」，而 CIA 實測設有強制模組與工作坊，另有 APLC 高級課程**；**即把「操守」做成必須完成的學分與可參加的課程**（可與 [[ifoa]]、[[actuaries-institute]]、[[cii]]、[[anziif]]、[[loma]] 的繼續教育體系對照）。**② ⭐ 「三個並列監察委員會」值得單獨注意**——**準則委員會（定標準）／職業行為委員會（管行為）／職業操守與資格監察委員會（查操守與資格）分開**；**與同輪 [[asb-us]]、[[abcd]] 在美國分屬不同機構形成對照：美國是「跨機構分工」，加拿大是「同一協會內設三個委員會」**。**③ 「Rules of Professional Conduct and why they are important」這一頁名值得注意**——**不只列規則，還解釋「為什麼重要」**。**④ 英法雙語站點**（**僅核實標題含英法名稱，未核實兩語版本是否等長**）。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**①** 本次核實到**首頁與六個頁面的存在、標題、體量、導航逐字實測的三委員會與教育架構**，**但未打開職業行為規則正文、未打開任何投訴或紀律案例、未打開強制模組或工作坊內容、未核實 CPD 學時要求**，故**不能轉述任何規則條款、案件、學時數值或課程內容**；**② ⭐ 「強制性」依據頁面名「Mandatory Professionalism Module」與導航歸屬**，**未打開該頁核實適用範圍、豁免條件與考核方式**——**故不主張誰必須完成、何時完成、未完成有何後果**；**③ 三機構職能劃分依據導航分組名與頁面標題**，**未打開各委員會頁核實權責邊界**——**詞條內對三者職能的表述為依據名稱的合理描述，已在此標注**；**④ CIA 與加拿大各省監管、與 [[osfi-canada-data]] 的關係未核實**（**故不作關聯陳述**）；**⑤ 英法兩語版本內容完整度是否一致未核實**；**⑥ 會員規模與成立年份未核實**；**⑦** 本詞條**不主張** CIA 提供精算軟件、模型或可下載數據**。**核實說明**：七個 URL 均經**緩衝區安全探活工具 `discovery/probe-urls.sh`** HTTP 200 實測並逐字讀取標題與導航；**未打開規則正文、投訴案例、模組或工作坊內容**。
